    public static class Deployment
    {
        public const string Identity = __IDENTITY__;
        public static readonly Dictionary<string, ItemDef> Items = new Dictionary<string, ItemDef>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        public static readonly Dictionary<string, LootEntry[]> Loot = new Dictionary<string, LootEntry[]>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        public static readonly Dictionary<string, Func<PackCreature>> Creatures = new Dictionary<string, Func<PackCreature>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, Placement[]> Decorations = new Dictionary<string, Placement[]>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private static readonly List<Action> Apply = new List<Action>();
        private static readonly List<PackRegion> PendingRegions = new List<PackRegion>();
        private static bool _configured, _loaded;
        [CallPriority(Int32.MaxValue)]
        public static void Configure()
        {
            if (_configured) return;
            // Run after native map/data-path configuration and before World.Load.
            Build();
            foreach (Action action in Apply) action();
            _configured = true;
        }
        public static void Initialize()
        {
            if (_loaded) return;
            Configure();
            // Native Region.Load runs between Configure and Initialize. Refuse conflicts before serving players.
            foreach (PackRegion region in PendingRegions)
                if (region.Map.Regions.ContainsKey(region.Name)) throw new InvalidDataException("GUO: region name already exists: " + region.Name);
            foreach (PackRegion region in PendingRegions) region.Register();
            _loaded = true;
            CommandSystem.Register("GUOPackItem", AccessLevel.GameMaster, GiveItem);
            CommandSystem.Register("GUOPackLoot", AccessLevel.GameMaster, GiveLoot);
            CommandSystem.Register("GUOPackCreature", AccessLevel.GameMaster, GiveCreature);
            CommandSystem.Register("GUOPackDecorate", AccessLevel.Administrator, Decorate);
            CommandSystem.Register("GUOPackUndecorate", AccessLevel.Administrator, Undecorate);
            Console.WriteLine("[GUO content] Loaded deployment " + Identity);
        }
        private static void Build()
        {
__BUILD__
        }
        private static Map Facet(int id)
        {
            if (id < 0 || id >= Map.Maps.Length || Map.Maps[id] == null || Map.Maps[id] == Map.Internal) throw new InvalidDataException("GUO: unknown facet " + id);
            return Map.Maps[id];
        }
        private static void Bounds(Map map, int x, int y)
        {
            if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= map.Width || y >= map.Height) throw new InvalidDataException("GUO: position exceeds facet bounds");
        }
        private static void StageBlock(int facet, int x, int y, LandTile[] land, StaticTile[][][] statics)
        {
            Map map = Facet(facet); Bounds(map, x*8+7, y*8+7);
            Apply.Add(delegate { map.Tiles.SetLandBlock(x,y,land); if (statics != null) map.Tiles.SetStaticBlock(x,y,statics); });
        }
        private static StaticTile[][][] StaticCells(StaticTile[] flat, int[] xs, int[] ys)
        {
            StaticTile[][][] result = new StaticTile[8][][];
            for (int x=0;x<8;x++) { result[x]=new StaticTile[8][]; for(int y=0;y<8;y++) {
                List<StaticTile> cell=new List<StaticTile>(); for(int i=0;i<flat.Length;i++) if(xs[i]==x && ys[i]==y) cell.Add(flat[i]); result[x][y]=cell.ToArray();
            }}
            return result;
        }
        private static void StageRegion(string name, int facet, int priority, Rectangle3D[] areas, string enter, string exit, int music)
        {
            Map map=Facet(facet);
            if(map.Regions.ContainsKey(name)) throw new InvalidDataException("GUO: region name already exists: "+name);
            foreach(Rectangle3D area in areas) { Bounds(map,area.Start.X,area.Start.Y); Bounds(map,area.End.X-1,area.End.Y-1); }
            PackRegion region=new PackRegion(name,map,priority,areas,enter,exit);
            if(music >= 0) region.Music=(MusicName)music;
            PendingRegions.Add(region);
        }
        private static void StageDecorations(string identity, Placement[] placements)
        {
            foreach(Placement p in placements) Bounds(Facet(p.Facet),p.X,p.Y);
            Decorations.Add(identity, placements);
        }
        private static string Argument(CommandEventArgs e) { return e.Length==1 ? e.GetString(0) : ""; }
        private static void GiveItem(CommandEventArgs e)
        {
            ItemDef definition; if(!Items.TryGetValue(Argument(e),out definition)) { e.Mobile.SendMessage("Usage: GUOPackItem pack:component"); return; }
            e.Mobile.AddToBackpack(definition.Create());
        }
        private static void GiveLoot(CommandEventArgs e)
        {
            LootEntry[] entries; if(!Loot.TryGetValue(Argument(e),out entries)) { e.Mobile.SendMessage("Usage: GUOPackLoot pack:component"); return; }
            List<Item> items=Roll(entries); Bag bag=new Bag();
            try { foreach(Item item in items) bag.DropItem(item); e.Mobile.AddToBackpack(bag); }
            catch { foreach(Item item in items) item.Delete(); bag.Delete(); throw; }
        }
        private static void GiveCreature(CommandEventArgs e)
        {
            Func<PackCreature> create; if(!Creatures.TryGetValue(Argument(e),out create)) { e.Mobile.SendMessage("Usage: GUOPackCreature pack:component"); return; }
            PackCreature creature=create(); try { creature.MoveToWorld(e.Mobile.Location,e.Mobile.Map); } catch { creature.Delete(); throw; }
        }
        public static List<Item> Roll(LootEntry[] entries) { return Roll(entries, Utility.RandomDouble); }
        public static List<Item> Roll(LootEntry[] entries, Func<double> random)
        {
            List<Item> result=new List<Item>();
            try { foreach(LootEntry e in entries) {
                double chance=random(); if(double.IsNaN(chance)||chance<0||chance>=1) throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid loot RNG");
                if(chance>=e.Chance) continue;
                double quantity=random(); if(double.IsNaN(quantity)||quantity<0||quantity>=1) throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid loot RNG");
                int count=e.Min+(int)(quantity*(e.Max-e.Min+1)); for(int i=0;i<count;i++) result.Add(e.Item.Create());
            } return result; } catch { foreach(Item item in result) item.Delete(); throw; }
        }
        private static void Decorate(CommandEventArgs e)
        {
            string id=Argument(e); Placement[] wanted;
            if(!Decorations.TryGetValue(id,out wanted)) { e.Mobile.SendMessage("Usage: GUOPackDecorate pack:component"); return; }
            ApplyDecorations(id);
            e.Mobile.SendMessage("GUO decorations reconciled. Save the world to persist changes.");
        }
        public static void ApplyDecorations(string id)
        {
            Placement[] wanted=Decorations[id];
            Dictionary<string, PackDecoration> owned=new Dictionary<string, PackDecoration>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach(Item item in World.Items.Values) {
                PackDecoration d=item as PackDecoration;
                if(d!=null && !d.Deleted && d.Group==id) {
                    if(owned.ContainsKey(d.Key)) throw new InvalidDataException("GUO: duplicate decoration ownership; repair before applying");
                    owned.Add(d.Key,d);
                }
            }
            // No boot-time placement. Only a staff command reconciles this adapter's own persistent type.
            foreach(Placement p in wanted) {
                PackDecoration d; if(!owned.TryGetValue(p.Key,out d)) d=new PackDecoration(id,p.Key,p.Graphic);
                d.ItemID=p.Graphic; d.Hue=p.Hue; d.Movable=false; d.MoveToWorld(new Point3D(p.X,p.Y,p.Z),Facet(p.Facet)); owned.Remove(p.Key);
            }
            foreach(PackDecoration stale in owned.Values) stale.Delete();
        }
        private static void Undecorate(CommandEventArgs e)
        {
            string id=Argument(e); if(id.Length==0) { e.Mobile.SendMessage("Usage: GUOPackUndecorate pack:component"); return; }
            int removed=RemoveDecorations(id);
            e.Mobile.SendMessage("GUO removed "+removed+" owned placements. Save the world.");
        }
        public static int RemoveDecorations(string id)
        {
            List<PackDecoration> owned=new List<PackDecoration>();
            foreach(Item item in World.Items.Values) { PackDecoration d=item as PackDecoration; if(d!=null && d.Group==id) owned.Add(d); }
            foreach(PackDecoration item in owned) item.Delete();
            return owned.Count;
        }
    }

        public ItemDef(string identity,int graphic,string name,double weight,bool movable) { Identity=identity;Graphic=graphic;Name=name;Weight=weight;Movable=movable; }
        public Item Create() { return new PackItem(this); }
        public void Write(GenericWriter w) { w.Write(Identity);w.Write(Graphic);w.Write(Name);w.Write(Weight);w.Write(Movable); }
        public static ItemDef Read(GenericReader r) { return new ItemDef(r.ReadString(),r.ReadInt(),r.ReadString(),r.ReadDouble(),r.ReadBool()); }
    }

    {
        public string Identity;
        public PackItem(ItemDef d) : base(d.Graphic) { Identity=d.Identity;Name=d.Name;Weight=d.Weight;Movable=d.Movable; }

        public override void Serialize(GenericWriter w) { base.Serialize(w);w.Write(0);w.Write(Identity); }
        public override void Deserialize(GenericReader r) { base.Deserialize(r);if(r.ReadInt()!=0) throw new InvalidDataException("Unknown GUO item save version");Identity=r.ReadString(); }

    public sealed class LootEntry
    {
        public ItemDef Item; public double Chance; public int Min, Max;
        public LootEntry(ItemDef item,double chance,int min,int max) { Item=item;Chance=chance;Min=min;Max=max; }
        public void Write(GenericWriter w) { Item.Write(w);w.Write(Chance);w.Write(Min);w.Write(Max); }
        public static LootEntry Read(GenericReader r) { return new LootEntry(ItemDef.Read(r),r.ReadDouble(),r.ReadInt(),r.ReadInt()); }
    }
    public class PackCreature : BaseCreature
    {
        public string Identity;
        public LootEntry[] ContentLoot;
        public PackCreature(string identity,AIType ai,LootEntry[] loot) : base(ai,FightMode.Aggressor,10,1,0.2,0.4) { Identity=identity;ContentLoot=loot; }
        public PackCreature(Serial serial) : base(serial) { }
        public override void GenerateLoot() {
            if(m_Spawning || ContentLoot==null) return;
            foreach(Item item in Deployment.Roll(ContentLoot)) PackItem(item);
        }
        public override void Serialize(GenericWriter w) {
            base.Serialize(w);w.Write(0);w.Write(Identity);w.Write(ContentLoot==null ? 0 : ContentLoot.Length);
            if(ContentLoot!=null) foreach(LootEntry entry in ContentLoot) entry.Write(w);
        }
        public override void Deserialize(GenericReader r) {
            base.Deserialize(r);if(r.ReadInt()!=0) throw new InvalidDataException("Unknown GUO creature save version");Identity=r.ReadString();
            int count=r.ReadInt();if(count<0||count>64) throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid saved GUO loot count");
            ContentLoot=new LootEntry[count];for(int i=0;i<count;i++) ContentLoot[i]=LootEntry.Read(r);
        }
    }

    public class PackRegion : Region
    {
        private readonly string _enter,_exit;
        public PackRegion(string name,Map map,int priority,Rectangle3D[] areas,string enter,string exit) : base(name,map,priority,areas) { _enter=enter;_exit=exit; }
        public override void OnEnter(Mobile m) { base.OnEnter(m);if(m.Player && _enter.Length>0) m.SendMessage(_enter); }
        public override void OnExit(Mobile m) { base.OnExit(m);if(m.Player && _exit.Length>0) m.SendMessage(_exit); }
